news.title: Envoy Aerospace Acquisition Completed
news.text: Astronics closed the $8 million purchase of Envoy Aerospace, expanding FAA certification services for aircraft connectivity and cabin modifications.

news.title: New Land Mobile Radio Service Monitor Announced
news.text: Astronics unveiled a new land mobile radio service monitor designed to enhance field testing capabilities for communications customers.

news.title: Q2 2025 Earnings Show Aerospace Strength
news.text: Astronics reported Q2 revenue of $204.7 million, a 3.3% increase, led by a 9.4% surge in Aerospace sales and raised full-year guidance.

news.title: Convertible Notes Offering Announced
news.text: The company planned a $210 million private offering of 0% convertible senior notes due 2031, with proceeds earmarked for capped calls and debt repurchases.

news.title: Convertible Notes Issued and Proceeds Deployed
news.text: Astronics issued $225 million in 0% convertible senior notes due 2031, repurchasing $132 million of 5.500% notes due 2030 and entering capped call transactions.

news.title: Truist Financial Raises Price Target to $58
news.text: Truist Financial lifted its Astronics price target from $49 to $58 with a Buy rating, citing accelerating growth.

news.title: Craig-Hallum Initiates Coverage at Buy
news.text: Craig-Hallum initiated coverage with a Buy rating and $60 price target, noting significant upside potential for Astronics shares.

news.title: Bühler Motor Aviation Acquisition Announced
news.text: Astronics agreed to acquire Bühler Motor Aviation, adding seat actuation systems and expanding its motion control portfolio.

news.title: New $300 Million Credit Facility Secured
news.text: The company replaced its prior credit agreement with a $300 million revolver running through 2030 to bolster financial flexibility for future investments.
